svg.metadata: {"id": "s048", "name": "恐龙化石馆", "cat": "科学", "tags": ["科学", "古生物", "恐龙", "博物馆"], "desc": "恐龙化石展厅：拱窗下的展台上是一副完整的长颈蜥脚类恐龙骨架，两侧展柜陈列菊石和恐龙蛋，红绳围栏与地面脚印。", "stand": {"ground_y": 930, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "windows", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "light", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.7, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "banners", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.5, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "plinth", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "skeleton", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cases", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "rope", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.95, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pterosaur", "enter": "drop", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#D6E3EC", "wall2": "#BCCFDD", "arch": "#F4F8FB", "win1": "#CDE8F5", "win2": "#F7FCFF", "trim": "#A9BDCC", "floor1": "#D6AE82", "floor2": "#B98D66", "plinth": "#C27C5C", "plinth2": "#A3624A", "top": "#D99878", "bone": "#FFF5E2", "bone2": "#EAD7B4", "bone3": "#D2BA92", "rod": "#7E8792", "case": "#FFFFFF", "glass": "#D9F1F4", "stone": "#BCA68C", "stone2": "#9E876F", "egg": "#F0E2C8", "egg2": "#DCC7A2", "rope": "#C8455A", "post": "#D2A957", "ban1": "#5FA38E", "ban2": "#F2A65A", "ban3": "#E57766", "foot": "#B68E68"}}
